scope: Portable core/PDF backend prototype; no native installer or all-feature release certification

runtime.verification_scope: Package presence only; not model/account/service validation

verified: Relocated executable in a path with spaces starts without source checkout, host Python, PYTHONPATH or commands on PATH.
Private stdin launch authentication and handshake succeed; anonymous API access is denied.
Authenticated agent creation writes workspace YAML; bundled UI, vendor library and favicon are served.
PDF upload and preview dispatch the fixed worker through the frozen executable.
Parent EOF shuts down the owned backend with exit status zero.
Failed compilation or concurrent build-input changes preserve the previous artifact.
pending: Reviewed SDK-complete profile and actual invocation of each selected capability; current prototype includes pypdf but not optional provider/database/voice SDKs.
Native Tauri package installation with this executable and one-file bootloader lifecycle/active external descendant cleanup.
Native Linux and Windows builds, clean installation, update, signing and OS permission acceptance.
Models, account credentials, host CLI subscriptions, Docker/Node, physical device and personal VM acceptance remain separate.
migration: No persisted schema changes. Source-mode worker commands retain their existing module or isolated-file execution. Development wrapper requires explicit opt-in; default packaging fails rather than falling back.
